claims.text: The total diffusion coefficient κ is the sum of molecular diffusivity (κ_m) and wave-induced diffusivity (κ_v).
Molecular diffusivity κ_m is given as 1.4 × 10^-7 m s^-2, while wave-induced diffusivity κ_v is calculated using a specific formula.
The wave-induced diffusivity κ_v is dependent on wave parameters and can vary significantly compared to the constant molecular diffusivity κ_m.
